svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 30 mm off 40 x 30 mm bar: a block 40 wide, 30 deep, 30 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 40 x 30 face that goes on the plate is the back face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Jack hole: drill 10.2 mm top to bottom, 18 from the back face, on the centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line, square to the top; tap M12 the full 30 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fixing holes: two 6.6 mm holes front to back, 12 each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: half way up; counterbore 11 mm, 6.5 deep, from the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: back face on the plate front, top flush with the plate's top edge;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two M6 x 30 cap screws into the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The M12 x 70 jack screw goes up through it, head below, lock nut

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the block; its end bears on the top flange 22 mm above.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the jack screw turns freely through the full thread.
